page_title: Endgame: Your Cosmic Box Office Forecast
date_caption: Created October 5, 2026 for the 41st week of 2026.

news.title: ‘Avengers: Endgame’ Returns to No. 1 on All-Time Global Box Office Chart, Surpassing ‘Avatar’ - The Hollywood Reporter

weekly_forecast: This week, prepare for a cinematic shake-up that will make your personal dramas seem like a low-budget indie. With 'Avengers: Endgame' reclaiming its throne, the universe is clearly signaling that the past isn't quite done with us yet. Expect old rivalries to resurface, forgotten snacks to be found, and a general sense that someone, somewhere, is about to release a 'Director's Cut' of your life decisions. Brace yourselves, because Doomsday is apparently just a matinee away.
